I mean, just wow! Isn't TextWorld just the best? You can make out an oven. You lean against the wall, inadvertently pressing a secret button. The wall opens up to reveal a table. The table is massive. On the table you see a cookbook. You see a counter. You see a chopped raw red potato and a raw purple potato on the counter. You can see a stove. Looks like someone's already been here and taken everything off it, though. Oh! Why couldn't there just be stuff on it?
